title: Ruleset manifest
description: rules/<id>/ruleset.yaml of a pack: a ruleset, the tables it uses and its sections (docs/architecture/rulesets.md). packages/engine/ruleset/src/ruleset.cpp applies the same rules, and also that the id is the name of the folder.

id.description: The ruleset's id: the name of its folder under rules/.

name.description: The name shown to players and designers.

extends.description: Another ruleset whose sections, tables and scripts this one starts from; its own replace them, section by section and table by table.

tables.description: The tables of the packs the ruleset uses, by role: digimon, evolution, raise, training, moves, items... Each value is an asset id.

sections.description: The sections this ruleset defines, each in rules/<id>/<section>.yaml with its schema ruleset_<section>.

scripts.description: Lua files of the ruleset's folder, for strategies written in Lua.
